description: Get the beers a brewery makes, by brewery id, with per-beer global rating, check-in count, ABV, style and in_production. Supports sorting and paging. Get an id from untappd_search_brewery. Lists are CACHED locally for 7 days (source:"cache"|"api", fetched_at, expires_at): a fresh cached list answers without an API call — the default popularity order from the cached top-of-list, other sorts once the whole list is cached (sorted locally). refresh:true re-fetches. The compact result has the same keys with or without the cache (source:"api" and null fetched_at/expires_at when no cache is available), with pagination {offset, limit, next_offset}. Untappd's per-beer has_had / your-count on this endpoint describe the AUTHENTICATED account, never the user you are asking about, so have_had / your_count are never cached or returned on either path — use untappd_cache_has_had_many for any user. With the cache, the result carries favorite {is_favorite, sources, reason} for the brewery and on each favorite beer (derived from username's history or added with untappd_favorite_add; default your account). view:"full" always calls Untappd and returns its raw page. Read-only.

refresh.description: Re-fetch from Untappd even if a fresh cached list exists (default false)

username.description: Whose favorites to mark (cache only; default your configured account)

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps each beer's identity, rating and counts and drops the description, label URLs and the copy of this brewery repeated on every row; "full" returns Untappd's whole page (always fetched live).

name: untappd_brewery_beers
title: Get a brewery's beer list
